title: CSOAI public card v0
description: Permissionless public-state card. Coverage, not a client. Measurement, not certification. Canonical form: UTF-8 JSON, sorted keys, separators (',', ':'), ensure_ascii=false. SHA-256 over that UTF-8. 3KB hard cap on the canonical payload object. UNMEASURED[] is required for missing fields — never invent.

sig_ed25519.description: Hex Ed25519 over canonical payload. null = UNMEASURED (laptop cannot use did:web:csoai.org#board-attestation-1).

did.description: Intended verify DID. Layer-0 seals of the Merkle root are a different key.
